purpose: Optimize temporal possession objects, rather than only frame classification
native_confirmation: No intact native confirmation remains. J03WR9 is not reopened for tuning or new confirmation claims.
planned_losses: inverse segment length CE plus boundary
soft temporal IoU over complete H/A training runs and their immediate neighboring runs
focal CE plus soft temporal IoU
same seeds and 800 updates as the original physics expert
inputs: Same 156 position/motion features as V6 physics expert, no new challenge-derived labels
decoder: Pre-existing fixed decoder and frozen boundary-conditioned Viterbi; no transition cost search
ensembles: Equal average with frozen V6 pair; boundary heads compared own vs original, no fitted blending weights
criterion: Mean official spellF1 across nine native development conditions, with per-game and worst-case reported. Do not count correlated noise conditions as independent games.
selection_uncertainty: Development is repeatedly used, so improvements there are exploratory. Repeat a promising method with seed2028. Do not claim an unbiased test improvement without new intact native games.
public_policy: No public competition GT opened or scored in V8, including after selection
